newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle steady-off $1.00 dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle steady-off $1.00 dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well established on a live basis. Demand and seller interest mostly light.
Slaughter Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1275-1300 lbs 71.00-72.00; load mostly Choice 72.50.
Slaughter Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 71.00.
Dressed Basis Delivered. Steers and heifers weak to 1.00 lower.
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1300 lbs 113.00-115.00; pen mostly Choice 116.00. ( weighted average 114.35 )
Dressed Basis Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 113.00-115.00. ( weighted average 114.03 )

For the week: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 2.00-3.00 lower; dressed basis 3.00-5.00 lower, most decline on predominately Select kinds. Weekly total includes 9,700 formulated and previously contracted cattle. Sales Confirmed: 1,100 Last Week: 5,200 Last Year: Holiday
Week To Date: 64,400 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 82,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr:25,400
